title: Claude built an Asset Panda alternative, and my spec forgot who already had laptops #shorts
description:
Free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/equipment-tracker?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=short&utm_campaign=equipment-tracker

Claude built an IT equipment tracker, an Asset Panda alternative with check-out and check-in, warranty reminders, asset checks and CSV import, from one written spec: all 21 acceptance checks passed, along with 116 automated tests. One of the 82 gaps the build exposed: the spec emailed the holder on every check-out, and importing an existing spreadsheet counted as one, so now an import records who has what without emailing anyone.

Asset Panda does not publish prices; its pricing page asks for details for a custom quote and offers a free 7-day trial (assetpanda.com/pricing, October 2026).

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera intro and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.
